newsitem.title: UK: Walker's recalls some potato crisps in UK.
newsitem.headline: Walker's recalls some potato crisps in UK.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc's UK unit Walker's Snack Foods Ltd said on Thursday it was recalling some of its crisps, or potato chips, due to concerns that pieces of glass may have got into some of the packets.
Walker's, one of Britain's leading snack food brands, said the recall included a limited number of cheese and onion crisps sold in multipacks and ready-salted crisps in single packs.
The company said it was investigating an equipment malfunction on one of its production lines.
"This may lead to pieces of glass from one, four-inch optical lens being found in certain packs," the company said.
"As a consequence, the company cannot be fully confident of the quality of a small quantity of crisps which were manufactured over the last few days," it added.
Its statement contained no estimate for the cost of the recall.
